html:
G'oya

Ikki ko'rinishni ajratib olish oson: Samarqand sanasida nuqta bor, Toshkentnikida yo'q. Nuqtali sanani SUBSTR bilan uch bo'lakka bo'lib, teskari tartibda chiziqcha bilan yig'amiz. Qolganiga tegmaymiz.

Yechim

SELECT id,
       CASE WHEN visit_date LIKE '__.__.____'
            THEN SUBSTR(visit_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(visit_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(visit_date, 1, 2)
            ELSE visit_date
       END AS visit_date
FROM visits

LIKE andozasida _ bitta istalgan belgi. '__.__.____' aynan "ikki belgi, nuqta, ikki belgi, nuqta, to'rt belgi" degani. 05.03.2026 da 7-belgidan yil, 4-belgidan oy, 1-belgidan kun boshlanadi.

Tuzoqlar

Kun va oyni almashtirib qo'yish oson: 05.03.2026 5-mart, 3-may emas. Xato sezilmasligi ham mumkin, chunki 03.05.2026 dan yasalgan 2026-05-03 ham haqiqiy sana:

Noto'g'riSELECT id,
       CASE WHEN visit_date LIKE '%.%'
            THEN SUBSTR(visit_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(visit_date, 1, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(visit_date, 4, 2)
            ELSE visit_date
       END AS visit_date
FROM visits

REPLACE(visit_date, '.', '-') ham yetmaydi: 05-03-2026 chiqadi, tartib baribir teskari.
